sources.entry: DigitalOcean: $200 in platform credit for 1 year, perfect for hosting your AI projects or deploying models.

summary.name: DigitalOcean
summary.one_liner: DigitalOcean is a cloud provider that positions itself as an AI-native platform, combining managed agents, serverless inference, databases, and GPU infrastructure.
use_cases: Serving open-weight and frontier LLMs via one API
Running GPU-based model training or inference
Storing vectors and data for RAG applications
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an integrated cloud stack covering agent runtimes, serverless, dedicated and batch inference over 75+ models on one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and an Inference Router that picks models per call. It lists managed databases, vector databases, knowledge bases and PostgreSQL/MySQL/Valkey/OpenSearch support. It also lists GPU infrastructure (NVIDIA H100/H200/B300 and AMD Instinct MI300X through MI355X) across 20 data centers in 12 regions, with a CLI and API. Observability products (Insights, Signals, Evaluations) are described as a self-improvement loop for agents. Some products are listed as in public or private preview.
notable: Inference Router that automatically picks a model per request on one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Owns its GPU silicon and data centers (20 data centers across 12 regions, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs)
Open-source integrations including vLLM, SGLang, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, OpenTelemetry and MCP
Listed in awesome-ai-tools under GitHub Student Developer Pack with $200 platform credit for one year
caveats: Many products (Harness Runtime, Action Gateway, MicroVMs, Agent Data Services, Managed Agents) are in public or private preview
Pricing details are not stated on the page; the $200 student credit comes from the directory listing, not the page itself
Page is mostly marketing; performance and cost claims are vendor-reported, with some cited from customers or Artificial Analysis benchmarks
